Lower Text: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When you play a Digimon with [Four Great Dragons] in its traits, 1 of those Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ for the turn. (This Digimon may attack the turn it was played.)
Upper Text: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 yellow card with [Angel] in its traits and 1 card with [Four Great Dragons] in its traits among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
